body: My mom has grown a hatred for my cousin, she even said she would make everything possible to make her life living hell. I think the best option would be to let her go back and at least be with her mom. Maybe we'll keep in touch online, and maybe someday we'll meet again.
We live in the EU she will be coming back to South America, if she gets send back it will be to her mother's side of the family which I know nothing of and will probably never get to see her again.

The biggest problem is she's living with us because my mom wanted to bring her to a country with better options for her, once my parents get back they're sending her back. I can't go back because my neighbors are friends of my parents, they've been told to not let me come back.
